name: VitalDB
purpose: Vital-sign noise (spread and AR(1) autocorrelation) for the monitor and LitePhysio
licence: Depends on the copy: CC BY 4.0 on PhysioNet (VitalDB 1.0.0); the vitaldb.net open dataset and its API, which our extract read, are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 under the VitalDB data use agreement (research and development use)
contents_checked: yes: case table 6,388 cases and track list read; 40 planned ASA 1-2 general-surgery cases sampled
notes: Intra-operative, so the values describe stable monitored patients, not an awake bay patient. Cite Lee et al., Sci Data 2022. Licence refresh 16 Oct 2026: our aggregates were read through the vitaldb.net API (non-commercial terms); the same data is published on PhysioNet under CC BY 4.0, so the aggregates are to be re-derived from the PhysioNet release before any commercial use (DT-183). Card: datasets/DS-0001-vitaldb.md

name: PTB-XL 1.0.3
purpose: Lead II beat templates for sinus rhythm, sinus tachycardia and atrial fibrillation (monitor trace)
contents_checked: yes: ECG strips drawn from real recordings too (content/ecg); metadata file and 73 recordings read; licence page read
notes: Cite Wagner et al., Sci Data 2020. Also the source of the 28 real ECG rhythm strips (sinus rhythm, tachycardia, bradycardia, atrial fibrillation, heart block, SVT, ST elevation) and the base of 12 edited ones, with reports, in content/ecg (approved for training on the owner's statement). Card: datasets/DS-0002-ptbxl.md

name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo 2.2
purpose: Plausibility check of lab bands and generated results (adult hospital patients)
contents_checked: yes: whole archive read (100 patients); percentiles for 14 tests
status: USED (reference and tests only, not shipped)
notes: Hospital patients, so wider than a healthy reference range. ODbL: attribution required, share-alike for derived databases (why nothing is shipped). Card: datasets/DS-0003-mimic-iv-demo.md

name: MIMIC-IV-ED Demo 2.2
purpose: Triage vitals of ED patients with abdominal complaints (S2 arrival realism)
contents_checked: yes: triage table read (222 rows, 27 abdominal)
status: USED (reference and tests only, not shipped)

name: UIdataGB (Gallblader Diseases Dataset) v2
purpose: Real gallbladder ultrasound images for the EMR viewer
contents_checked: yes: file list and licence read; 5 class archives downloaded and checksum-verified; images looked at
status: USED (16 images, approved for training on the owner's statement)
notes: Classes used: Carcinoma, Gallstones, Membranous and gangrenous cholecystitis, Perforation, cholecystitis. No images for bile-duct findings or sludge. Labels were not clinician-checked by us. Attribution required. Card: datasets/DS-0005-uidatagb.md

name: NIH ChestX-ray14
purpose: Real chest X-rays for the EMR viewer (consolidation, effusion, pneumothorax, cardiomegaly, oedema, atelectasis, no finding) and the base of the free-air film
licence: NIH Clinical Center terms: no restrictions on use, attribution required (read in the Google Cloud and RSNA documentation; the NIH page itself is script-driven and could not be read; the Hugging Face copy states no licence)
access: Open download; only one 450 MB shard of the 45 GB copy is used
contents_checked: yes: one shard read (32 pictures chosen by eye from contact sheets); labels only, no radiology reports
status: USED (32 images, approved for training on the owner's statement)
notes: Labels are text-mined and not clinician-checked, so reports state only what the label supports. Patient id, age and sex are not copied. Oedema rarely stands alone, so its pictures also carry the usual companion labels. Four shards (about 4,500 films) were read. The NIH Clinical Center news release (27 September 2017) says the dataset is freely accessible to the scientific community; the 'no restrictions, attribution required' wording comes from the Google Cloud and RSNA documentation; the Box page itself is script-driven and could not be read. Card: datasets/DS-0006-nih-chestxray14.md

name: openFDA Drug Label API
purpose: Contraindication and boxed-warning wording for the medicine groups (never doses)
contents_checked: yes: 22 labels queried and read (tools/data/extract_openfda.py); sentences with doses dropped
notes: US labels as stand-ins for the UK product of the same group; aspirin and adrenaline returned no usable label. Card: datasets/DS-0007-openfda.md

name: Regensburg Pediatric Appendicitis Dataset
licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Zenodo record 7669442, v1.01; latest v1.03, record 7711412, same licence)
notes: Children only: not suitable for the adult S2 cases. The non-commercial licence also rules it out for a product that is sold.

name: PriMock57
purpose: Medical conversation audio for the speech-recognition evaluation (P1)
access: Open download (Git LFS for the audio)
notes: Decision 10 Oct 2026: speech recognition uses an existing recogniser (for example Whisper or a cloud service), not a dataset we train on; a short authored phrase list recorded by the team is enough for the P0/P1 checks. Reconsider if accent robustness must be measured.

name: Mozilla Common Voice (accented English)
licence: not read: since October 2025 only distributed through Mozilla Data Collective under that site's terms; the dataset page there is script-driven and could not be read
notes: Decision 10 Oct 2026: not needed; existing speech recognisers already cover accents. Optional later for measuring accent robustness.

name: ProcSense synthetic ultrasound set
purpose: Labelled stand-in images where no real image exists (ADR-0003): ultrasound, ECG patterns, free-air chest film
contents_checked: yes: 100 images rendered and looked at; mark read back from the pixels by CI
notes: Ultrasound: stylised procedural illustrations. CT/MRI: findings painted into real AMOS slices. MRCP: drawn entirely in code (clearly diagrammatic). Never a trained generative model; every image carries the visible mark. Card: datasets/DS-0011-synthetic-ultrasound.md

name: Indiana University Chest X-ray Collection (NLM Open-i)
purpose: Real chest X-rays with radiology reports (for EMR if a case needs one)
licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (read from the licence field of the report files)
contents_checked: yes: the 1 MB report archive downloaded and read; images not downloaded
notes: NoDerivatives forbids sharing resized or re-encoded copies and NonCommercial limits later use, so images cannot ship in the build. No P0 case shows a chest X-ray result (the S1 book case lists it as 'not ordered'). Reconsider only with written permission or a clinician-approved synthetic set.

name: AMOS 2022 (abdominal CT and MRI)
purpose: Real CT and MRI slices as the clean pictures, and as the base the synthetic findings are painted into (appendix level, gallbladder level)
licence: CC BY 4.0 (read from the Zenodo record)
access: Open download; single scans read out of the 24 GB archive with HTTP range requests
contents_checked: yes: archive index read, 13 scans downloaded and looked at; 16 real slices used
status: USED (16 real clean pictures; the base of 32 painted ones)
notes: Patients have many conditions and the dataset gives no per-slice diagnosis, so slices were chosen by eye and the clinician confirms they are clean. MRI appears to be post-contrast T1 fat-suppressed (not stated by us as fact). Card: datasets/DS-0014-amos.md

name: ProcSense authored EMR distractor identities
notes: Invented names, dates and numbers; no clinical content. Card: datasets/DS-0012-emr-distractors.md
